calls.label: Preflight call 1
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: God save you. What news of the parish?
calls.response:
Dia is Muire dhuit! The spring ploughing has every farmer wearing down their iron shares, though a drover through early brought dark word of the land agent in the next county. Have ye travelled far along the road this morning?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of a thick leather glove and smiles.*

calls.label: Preflight call 2
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: How does the harvest look this year?
calls.response:
Sure 'tis early yet to speak of a harvest with the seed only now going into the furrows, though the soil has turned over clean and willing. Le cúnamh Dé, we will see heavy ricks and fine ridges come the autumn. Do ye turn the land yerself, or follow another trade?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans a heavy hammer against the anvil and wipes his brow.*

calls.label: Preflight call 3
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: Have you seen Father Declan today?
calls.response:
I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan yet this morning, mo chara. He'll most likely be up about St. Brigid's Church or looking to his duties before the noon heat. Have ye a matter of parish business to put before him?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron rests his hammer lightly on the anvil with a hearty grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 4
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: And how is your own family keeping?
calls.response:
Buíochas le Dia, we're in grand fettle altogether! Maire keeps a bright hearth, and young Colm there is putting a fine, stout pair of shoulders on himself working the bellows.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a booming laugh and gestures toward the forge boy.*

calls.label: Preflight call 5
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?
calls.response:
I know no man by the name of Festus in these parts, mo chara, nor is there any cooper's shop down by the bridge. If 'tis seasoned hoops or barrel rings ye have need of, any ironwork of the sort comes through my own fire right here.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and rests a hand on the horn of the anvil.*

calls.label: Preflight call 6
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: How do I get to the abbey in town?
calls.response:
Mhuise, there is no abbey in these parts at all, nor any great town hereabouts. We have only St. Brigid's Church along the road if 'tis holy ground ye seek. Were ye told of some older ruins further out in the county?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron rests a heavy hammer on the anvil with a hearty grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 7
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.
calls.response:
Bedad, 'tis hot fire and honest iron from morning till dusk! I keep the parish moving with shoes for the horses, mend broken ploughshares for the neighbours, and fashion whatever fittings are needed.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron taps the flat of his hammer against the anvil and grins.*

calls.label: Preflight call 8
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?
calls.response:
A full day of hard labour is the surest remedy for a restless mind, for honest sweat will always earn a man sound sleep. Take a brisk walk in the crisp spring air to clear the weight from yer chest, mo chara, and leave tomorrow's troubles for tomorrow.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of a leather glove and grins.*

calls.label: Preflight call 9
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?
calls.response:
Aye, I know Padraig well, mo chara! He keeps Darcy's Pub, and there is no better man in the parish to share a bit of news or a warm hearth with. Have ye an errand to run with him this morning?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his hammer with a broad grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 10
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?
calls.response:
I cannot put a parish face to that name.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and rests a hand on his hammer.*

calls.label: Preflight call 11
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?
calls.response:
I cannot vouch for where Cormac is this very hour, though as our miller, The Mill is his usual place of work. Are ye needing some grain ground today, mo chara?
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans comfortably against the anvil with a broad grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 12
calls.npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
calls.question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.
calls.response:
Aye, the iron will not strike itself! Slán leat, and may your road be an easy one today.
*A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty nod and lifts his tongs toward the hearth.*
